steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In April 2024, Equity Mates contrasted bill comparison services like iSelect with a subscription alternative, saying sites such as iSelect earned rebates from providers and therefore compared only a subset of companies.

views.text: In January 2018, Equity Mates explained iSelect began as a health insurance comparison site and expanded into energy and telco comparisons, while also acting as Australia’s distributor for Nest smart home products.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In January 2018, Equity Mates noted iSelect had consistent revenue growth and a balance sheet with $18 million cash and no debt, but missed expectations and its share price fell 21% in 2017.

episode.title: EM Talk: We're Back For 2018 - Why Amazon Struggles & More Bold Predictions

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In January 2018, Equity Mates said iSelect reinvested for growth by expanding into energy and telcos and by becoming the Australian distributor for Nest smart home products.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In January 2018, Equity Mates reported iSelect traded at $1.39 with a price to earnings of 19 after a 21% share price fall in 2017, and discussed mean reversion in that context.
